integrity: The general formula is proved directly from the geometry of rank-one idempotents and a determinant identity. Exhaustive computations over four prime fields are corroborative only and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to two-by-two full matrix algebras. A 2018 dissertation reports ring-level clean-index calculations for matrix rings over integers modulo n; its inaccessible full text leaves a residual risk of an overlapping elementwise prime-field formula.
title: Exact clean-decomposition multiplicities for two-by-two finite-field matrices
